capabilities: Copy local AI tool config files into Markdown snapshots in the vault
Group snapshots by machine and tool folder
Sync snapshots on plugin load, settings change, or ribbon click
Apply a snapshot note back to the local config file with a timestamped backup
Add custom config file or folder sources (.toml, .json, .yaml)
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not switch AI models yet; it currently syncs and applies config file snapshots, with model switching listed on the roadmap.
extras: Read-only for system config directories; applying a snapshot asks for confirmation and writes a timestamped backup first. Model/provider presets and safer write-back flows are still on the roadmap.
motivation: The README says the plugin will grow into "a helper for programming beginners to quickly switch and configure AI models."
problem: AI coding tool configuration files live outside the vault, so they are hard to view, compare, or edit from within Obsidian.
